title: Lag-2 identity rebound conditional on lag-1 recurrence
hypothesis: A number drawn two contests ago but absent from the immediately previous draw may have a different probability of appearing in the target draw, conditional on the immediately previous draw state.

definition.model: P(D_t|A_t,B_t) proportional to exp(beta1*x1 + beta2*x2), normalized over all 658008 5-subsets
definition.secondary_score: Multiclass Brier gain for the joint 6x6 PMF of (x1,x2), baseline minus candidate; positive favors candidate.

models.selection: Maximize mean exact-subset log gain on Validation only; ties prefer smaller L1 norm, then beta1 and beta2 ascending.

walk_forward.cutoff_rule: Target t uses only D_(t-1) and D_(t-2); both cutoffs are strictly earlier than target.

inference.multiple_testing: Holm across 14 non-null candidates for primary Blind OOS log-score tests; Holm across the two selected-model endpoints.

guardrails: Protocol is exploratory because initial computation preceded persistence; no confirmatory claim.
No target or later draw enters its forecast state.
Validation alone selects the model; Blind OOS is not used for tuning.
Normalizer exactly sums all 658008 five-number subsets through category counts.
No subgroup search or post-hoc grid expansion.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout.
No production scorer, Q60, H101/H102, freeze or model promotion changes.
